title: Certify a one-layer full-cover QQ16 F0-to-B1 exact grid
body:
## Summary

```text
bounded dyadic inputs across the whole owner cover
  -> literal F0, carrying all 712 field bounds
  -> literal B1, including native interiors and 528 cover moves
  -> sufficient quantum h*2^-71 and signed width P+215
```

Supplies the B1 numerical-reference obligation left outside PR3226's F0-only grid proof. Exactly one 73-axis tensor layer is covered, with `N = 2^73` per owner. The 512 normalization describes the local kernel. The full payload is not allocated or executed; native bridge and exact endpoint/restoration semantics remain inherited premises.

Symbolic per-owner bounds are `483082 N + 12` W-bit word operations, plus `2112 N` conceptual cover transfers and `1426 N + 12` numeric words. Physical routing, code/control storage, recursive tariffs, an admitted entry contract and the F17 consumer remain unpriced. No multi-layer, sharpness, full functional/native admission, supplier, selected-frontier or kappa claim.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3226 proves an exact grid for F0; PR3235's two-stage completed-error theorem leaves finite register widths and native interiors open.
  **After:** [PROOF.md](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4a83f89c3865d21521b4a72bb71e3a23c3aadbb7/research/qq16-f0-b1-exact-grid/PROOF.md) gives a uniform component induction through the literal F0→B_1_2 word, including actual carried state and 73-dimensional cover bijections.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes all three commands: 53,118 events, 270,288 primitive-bound observations, separate rational/integer agreement on every trace and operation count, and seven optimized behavioral groups. Ruff and formatting pass.
- The reviewed 18-file read-only, Git-free export passes all three direct scripts under optimized Python 3.13. Final publication adds only the exact REVIEW.json receipt: all 18 common files are identical, and all 19 publication-byte/export checks pass. Required predecessor bytes are retained and authenticated; replay needs no pending-PR Git objects. Exact input/provenance usage mapping rejects both input-reclassification mutants.
- The assigned internal read-only peer review and proportional source-authentication recheck are recorded in [REVIEW.json](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4a83f89c3865d21521b4a72bb71e3a23c3aadbb7/research/qq16-f0-b1-exact-grid/REVIEW.json). This is not independent human or proof-kernel review. Full-payload execution, multi-layer powering, inherited bridge/endpoint replay, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and hosted CI are unrun.

Package: `research/qq16-f0-b1-exact-grid/`, with exact sources, receipts, reproduction commands, limits and Open next questions. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-19003553). Base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6; submission guidance and scientific inputs are unchanged.

Credit commdata2338/PR3226/3235, Sricharan Vagvala/PR3101, Nick Petalas/PR2965/3250/3258, Ali Romman's joint-query construction, Tekalign's native conventions, Ross Richardson, Arham Tahir and the retained supplier/bridge lineage. Frozen predecessors and the selected record are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated reference-contract package with opt-in bounded replay. No shared code, frozen inputs or selected-result changes.
